unmodified. They are licensed under the **ISC License**; the icons derived from the Feather project are

Any output that embeds these icons (exported HTML, SVG, ZIP) must include the text of `LICENSE`
or the credit "Icons: Lucide (ISC, MIT for Feather-derived icons), https://lucide.dev".
